summary: Vehicle consistently pulls to the right, requiring constant steering correction even after multiple alignments and service inspections.
Automatic headlights fail intermittently, leaving the driver unable to tell whether the headlights are on during darkness.
Fuel pump repair led to hard starting, fuel odor, and engine shutting off while backing up and driving on the highway.
Self-leveling rear shocks became noisy over bumps, failed twice at low mileage, and had to be replaced repeatedly.
Sunroof glass shattered and collapsed into the vehicle while driving.
Parking brake warning light blinked and the vehicle would not move forward or reverse.
Steering wheel became hard to turn, vehicle drifted right, and it crashed into a mailbox, causing injuries and air bag deployment.
Water entered the vehicle through a cracked rear window seal.
Truck shook and became stranded due to failing engine lifters on both sides, eventually requiring a full engine replacement.
The vehicle would not shift into reverse or drive, then lost power and would not restart after warning lights came on.
Windshield suddenly cracked and spread into the driver’s line of sight while driving, creating a visibility hazard.
The engine has had excessive oil consumption, repeated misfiring, and a P0020 code, and it still is not running properly.
The driver's side rear brake light assembly detached from the vehicle while driving.
The PTU failed, spilled oil, and caused a fire, damaging the driveshaft and rear differential, with brief loss of steering.
Air bag warning light stayed on, and recall repair parts were unavailable for an air bag-related issue.
Fuel injectors repeatedly failed, causing shaking, loss of power, and leaking raw fuel with a strong fumes smell.
The engine failed with loud knocking and rattling after shifting, and the dealer said lifter failure caused the engine to need replacement.
Transmission rattles and dealer suspects a damaged flex plate, requiring an expensive transmission repair at low mileage.
Forward collision warning light stayed on and the sensor was diagnosed as needing replacement.
Drag link and tie rod links failed at highway speed, causing severe shaking and unsafe steering.
The dashboard display for the speedometer and RPMs went completely black when the vehicle was turned on.
Paint peeled along the roof line by the rear glass, exposing metal and risking rust.
The headlight module failed while driving at night, causing both headlights to go out and the vehicle to need towing.
Power steering warning lights came on, then steering assistance failed completely and the rack and pinion was found broken.
The power lift-gate strut failed, bent inward, and shattered the rear glass.
The vehicle would not accelerate above 60 mph and the dealer could not repair the power train issue because recall parts were unavailable.
Automatic emergency braking failed to activate for vehicles pulling in from the passenger side after a software update.
Right rear coil spring came off after hitting a road bump, leaving the rear of the car sitting uneven.
Vehicle suddenly shut down in traffic and would not restart because the fuel pumps failed and a fuse blew, leaving it immobilized.
Transmission warning lights came on, the truck got stuck in gear, skipped gears, surged forward, and the transmission needed replacement.
While turning, the steering arm dropped because a mounting bolt was missing and another bolt fell out.
Brake rotors and pads wore out repeatedly, with severe rotor damage and gouging at multiple mileage intervals, requiring replacement.
Warning lights came on while driving, indicating a powertrain failure.
Steering intermittently fails, especially while backing up or just after shifting to drive and moving forward.
Paint is peeling and coming off the hood, requiring costly repair.
The driver’s side door limiting bar detached when the door was opened, and the door was diagnosed as needing replacement.
Recall repair for the air bag system was unavailable for an extended time.
On bumpy roads, the brakes failed to engage twice, nearly causing an accident.
The panoramic sunroof shade sagged and blocked the rearview mirror, severely limiting rear visibility and obstructing the back seat area.
Condensation formed inside the tailgate light bar, matching a known recall issue with the rear lighting assembly.
Driver side mirror vibrates while driving, making the reflected image blurry.
After a hybrid battery recall repair, the vehicle showed a hybrid system warning and shut off while driving on the highway.
Engine made knocking noise, entered limp mode, lost power, and the crankshaft failed and needed replacement.
The horn stopped working and no sound occurred when pressed.
A recall was issued for an unspecified problem, and the remedy is not yet available.
A loose gas cap triggered an error that disabled all ADAS functions and warning lights until the dealer cleared the fault.
Rear suspension bolt was loose and nearly fell out, causing the rear tire to tilt inward and wear unevenly.
Both high beam headlamps stopped working because the shutter doors inside the headlamp assemblies became unresponsive.
Recall repair was unavailable, and the vehicle may lose the instrument cluster and safety features while driving.
The engine warning says the coolant bypass valve needs repair due to a suspected defect.
A software update caused the vehicle to stop recognizing speed signs, creating a dangerous risk of speeding through town.
Passenger airbag warning light stayed on and a recall remedy has been delayed for two years.
Side curtain airbags deployed unexpectedly without a confirmed collision, causing loss of control and the vehicle to leave the roadway.
Automatic emergency braking activated unexpectedly and repeatedly stopped the vehicle while driving.
Defective brakes caused sudden brake loss, with a dashboard message appearing after the incident.
Rear struts broke while driving on the highway at low mileage.
Rear back glass shattered after rear defrost was turned on in cold weather while driving.
Brake application sometimes delays and then catches abruptly, causing the vehicle to lunge forward before stopping.
The transmission makes a high-pitched whining noise when accelerating.
Fuel system issues are causing concern, and the dealer is asking for payment to replace the fuel assembly.
